question: Do eight connectivity-selected right-side upstream neurons drive firing in DNg02 cells in the fixed full-v783 LIF model, and does response require outgoing connections?
hypothesis: 8 graph-selected upstream inputs at150Hz for200ms increase pooled DNg02 firing vs sham; if A positive, B tests whether outgoing connectivity is necessary.
candidate_tests: A: upstream stimulation versus sham; 8 graph-selected inputs at150Hz for200ms, seeds42/43/44; measure mean DNg02 Hz across all25 readouts and paired differences.
B: outgoing-connectivity necessity control; identical input with stimulated inputs' outgoing synapses disconnected; measure fractional reduction vs driven output.

conditions.sham: 0Hz control stimulation for seeds42/43/44; expected null baseline in this design.
conditions.upstream_drive: 8 graph-selected upstream inputs at150Hz for200ms, seeds42/43/44.
conditions.outgoing_disconnection: candidate B only; not part of this A receipt and not yet measured here.
conditions.direct_calibration: separate calibration/feasibility context; not used as evidence for this A upstream effect.
conditions.manual_feasibility: separate manual feasibility context; not used as native A evidence.

actual_result: A completed. Sham DNg02 population mean rates were [0.0,0.0,0.0] Hz, mean 0.0. Upstream-drive rates were [17.2,18.8,18.4] Hz, mean 18.133333333333333 Hz, sample SD 0.8326663997864536. Paired differences were [17.2,18.8,18.4] Hz, all positive. Drive readout spike events were [86,94,92], active DNg02 readouts [14,14,13], nonstimulated active network cells [235,193,228].

result.decision_rule_applied: effect branch: all paired A differences positive with stable nonzero upstream-drive response and sham at 0Hz; proceed to outgoing-disconnection control rather than direct calibration or repeat-for-instability.

updated_decision: Run test B outgoing-disconnection causality control
decision_reason: The sealed A comparison shows an upstream-drive effect in the fixed full-v783 LIF model, but A only establishes numerical propagation from graph-selected inputs to DNg02 readouts. Because the hypothesis explicitly asks whether the response requires outgoing connections, the next measured experiment is the receipt-specified B control.
limitations: Model-only upstream propagation; no natural sensory pathway was tested.
No body behavior, no flight initiation, no stable flight, and no biological validation are implied.
Sham zero is expected under this design and is not biological silence evidence.
FAFB lacks the complete VNC/wing-muscle system needed for a full flight motor claim.
Literature claims, graph-selection assumptions, numerical propagation, motor adapter, and body physics remain separate evidence categories.
Receipt existence alone does not prove specialist dispatch; independent native trace audit remains pending.
